verdict.rationale: AngelList documents an HRIS/payroll integration under People > Configuration > Integrations with a selectable provider. It explicitly says it can "automatically terminate employees in AngelList when employees are terminated in your HRIS/payroll systems," and recorded terminations update the related securities on the cap table. The termination flow is covered, but the evidence does not say new hires are created as stakeholders automatically, nor which providers are supported. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of new-hire stakeholder sync, named supported providers (e.g. Gusto, Rippling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the sync.
